system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a multi-region Cloud Storage bucket with object lifecycle rules (delete after 365 days) and uniform bucket-level access.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a multi-region Cloud Storage bucket with object lifecycle rules (delete after 365 days) and uniform bucket-level access.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
  - name: multi-region-bucket
    type: storage.v1.bucket
    properties:
      location: multi-region
      storageClass: STANDARD
      uniformBucketLevelAccess:
        enabled: true
      lifecycle:
        rule:
          - action:
              type: Delete
            condition:
              age: 365
              isLive: true
      locationPolicy:
        locationRestriction: MULTI_REGION
      versioning:
        enabled: false
      retentionPolicy:
        retentionPeriod: null
      iamPolicy:
        bindings:
          - role: roles/storage.objectViewer
            members:
              - allUsers
          - role: roles/storage.objectCreator
            members:
              - allUsers
          - role: roles/storage.legacyObjectReader
            members:
              - allUsers
          - role: roles/storage.legacyBucketReader
            members:
              - allUsers
          - role: roles/storage.admin
            members:
              - serviceAccount:$(ref.service-account-email)
      labels:
        env: prod
        team: storage-admins
      bucketPolicyOnly:
        enabled: true
      defaultEventBasedHold: false
      defaultObjectAcl:
        role: READER
        entity: allUsers
      update:
        enabled: true
      metageneration: null
      timeCreated: null
      timeUpdated: null
      size: null
      etag: null
      kind: storage#bucket
      id: $(ref.multi-region-bucket.name)
      selfLink: $(ref.multi-region-bucket.selfLink)
      projectNumber: $(ref.project-number)
      project: $(ref.project-id)
